description: This source file contains unit tests for the ActivationCollector class in the Orleans runtime, covering functionality such as ticket creation from timestamps, memory overload detection, and deactivation logic.

classes.name: ActivationCollectorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for ActivationCollector, including ticket generation, memory overload detection, and deactivation order testing.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromDateTime
methods.description: Tests the creation of time-based tickets from DateTime objects, ensuring correct rounding and handling of max value.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromDateTime_MaxValue

methods.description: Checks that invalid timestamps earlier than the current ticket throw an ArgumentException.

methods.name: IsMemoryOverloaded_WorksAsExpected

methods.name: DeactivateInDueTimeOrder_OnlyOldestAndEligibleAreDeactivated
